description: Match your own company list to official Korean identifiers. On a free key — Free during the beta: one list of up to 1,000 rows a day, plus 200 requests a day. After that first list, each row uses one unit of your daily limit (200 units, shared with your other calls), and a request with more rows than you have left today is rejected as a whole — no rows are matched. usage.free_batch in the result says whether this call was the day's free list. Each row is a string or an object/array of cells — a company name and/or a business registration number (10 digits), corporate registration number (13), DART code (8) or stock code (6), in any order. Returns per row: result (matched / ambiguous / not_found / not_supported / invalid), match_type, entity_id, official numbers and the official English name; several equally good candidates are answered as ambiguous, not guessed. Identifiers only (tax status is free at verify_company). Rows are not stored. Requires a Jaryo API key (free: https://jaryo.org/keys/). (회사 목록 맞추기)
name: match_companies
title: Match a list of Korean companies
